newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: ZAMBIA SIGNS POWER DEALS WITH ZIMBABWE, ZAIRE.
newsitem.headline: ZAMBIA SIGNS POWER DEALS WITH ZIMBABWE, ZAIRE.

text.p: Zambia has signed electricity export contracts with neighbouring Zimbabwe and Zaire that will see it earning $1.3 million a month, Zambia Electricity Supply Corp (ZESCO) chief Robinson Mwansa said on Thursday.
Mwansa said Zambia would export 100MW of power to Zimbabwe every month and allow Zaire to use its transmission network to export power.

"The three utilities ... have entered a trading contract which enables ZESCO to supply 100 megawatts to Zimbabwe and also enables (the Zairean) Societe Nationale d'Electricte to export up to 150 megawatts of power to Zimbabwe using the Zambian transmssion network," Mwansa said.
He said the contracts were made under the Southern African Development Community power pool and would bring "enormous savings" to consumers in the sub-region.
The agreement will last until Zimbabwe set up a new power line to Cabora Bassa in Mozambique.
